_README: Recorded Android ML Kit body-pose skeletons for the Epic-3 Layer-1 regression test (Issue #22). Frame is ML Kit NATIVE -- image-PIXEL coordinates, top-left origin (y-down), anatomical labels -- i.e. the MlKitPoseAdapter INPUT, pre-normalize/pre-flip. Each is the output of ML Kit Pose Detection (bundled model, STREAM_MODE) run on the committed shared/native_fixtures/pose_<name>.png during Layer-2 calibration on a real device (Pixel 9a, Android 16), captured by MlKitCalibrationTest. Replayed through MlKitPoseAdapter, these must satisfy the same invariants.json the live calibration asserts -- the fast, emulator-free, per-commit guard on the Android adapter (the Layer-2 test re-derives them live on a device; ML Kit needs the Android runtime). Values are [x, y, confidence] in pixels; image_width/image_height are the analysed bitmap's dimensions, used to normalize. Regenerate by running 'cd android && ./gradlew :app:connectedDebugAndroidTest' against a connected device/emulator and pasting the CAPTURED_SKELETON blocks from 'adb logcat -s MlKitCalibration:I'.
_frame: ML Kit native: image-pixel [0..w]x[0..h], top-left origin (y-down), anatomical L/R labels.
